newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus Woolworth floats new shares.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus Woolworth floats new shares.

text.p: F.W. Woolworth (Cyprus) floated 4.36 million ordinary shares on the Cyprus Stock Exchange to cover its purchase of fashion accessories chain Zako last year, the company said on Monday.
"The share issue arises from the exchange of Zako shares for Woolworth shares," company secretary George Mitsides told Reuters.
The one-for-one share swop and Woolworth's takeover were endorsed by 99 percent of Zako shareholders in December, when the stock exchange suspended trading in Zako shares.
Woolworth initially bought 55 percent of Zako a year ago.

Woolworth is a wholly-owned subsidiary of N.K. Shakolas (Holdings) Ltd. Its shares were trading at 80 cents on Monday compared with 95 cents one month ago. ($=0.49 Cyprus pounds) -- Nicosia newsroom 3257 2 365089
